The model uses a derived kernel to map these shifts into measurable impacts on snap share and pressure dynamics. Cognitive signals add a layer of organizational coherence, influencing how effectively strategic changes are implemented. These three operators interweave to form a dynamic system where injury status, performance metrics, and team sentiment jointly determine game script outcomes.
